label: OmniTIK 5 ac
description: MikroTik OmniTIK 5 ac (RBOmniTikG-5HacD) — 5x 1G RJ45, Wi-Fi 5 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9557.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: Passive PoE** (12-57 V) on `eth1`. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption 14 W.
